excluded: 2 rows of voided attempts (P4 NS rough Voronoi-CNN MXR3 seeds 1101 / 1102, voided 2026-10-08): an infrastructure failure (checkpoint loading) after which both runs were trained again under the same ids; the repeated runs are included

168 classical rows (Darcy and Poisson V4-D references of the 128^2 slices) that equal part A exactly: both accounts computed them independently and agree in every mean and selected setting; part A keeps them
per_record_location: kept outside this repository (see README); hashes above identify the exported files (the per-record files still contain the 2 voided attempts)

update_20261021.note: runs_long.part-B.csv now equals the 2026-10-21 export of the same account minus the 2 voided attempts (the earlier rows unchanged, in the same order, plus the E5 rows). export_files above still describe the 2026-10-17 export, whose per-record and classical files are the ones published on Hugging Face (october2026/results/part-B/); the 2026-10-21 export's per-record files (listed here) are not published there.
